_comment: The publication allowlist. A section of a lore entry is set in the book ONLY if its heading is named here. Anything not named — a new heading, a renamed one, a whole new entry — is withheld until someone admits it deliberately. Deleting this file publishes nothing.
_matching: Headings are matched on lowercase text with surrounding punctuation ignored, so 'See also' and 'See also:' are the same heading. '(opening)' is the prose before an entry's first heading.
_allowIn: Headings particular to one entry. They are admitted for that entry only, so the same words in a different entry are still withheld.

alfran-longbritches: Old Berrick of the Barrel — provisional character development

_withheld: For the record, the headings deliberately NOT admitted anywhere: Art direction; Visual direction; Visual development; Visual references supplied by creator; Creator-supplied visual reference; Design shown in concept art; The May — visual reference; Working design direction; Names and earlier concepts; The five colleges — material to reconcile; Developing tabletop magic concept — not canon rules; Developing gameplay ideas — NOT settled rules; Rules; Proposed categories; Website layout contract.
_denyIn: Narrows the allowlist for one entry: how a single entry's 'Established lore' is held back when it carries something private, without stripping that heading from the twenty other entries using it. '*' withholds the whole entry. It can only take away, never give.
